sanskrit: agne yat te tapas tena taṃ prati tapa yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: O Agni, with that heat of yours, burn back him who hates us, whom we hate.

sanskrit: (…) te haras tena taṃ prati hara yo (…) ||
english: With that consuming flame of yours, consume back him who [hates us, whom we hate].

sanskrit: (…) te śocis tena taṃ prati śoca yo (…) ||
english: With that blazing glow of yours, blaze back against him who [hates us, whom we hate].

sanskrit: (…) te 'rcis tena taṃ praty arca yo (…) ||
english: With that fierce radiance of yours, radiate back against him who [hates us, whom we hate].

sanskrit: agne yat te jyotis tena taṃ prati daha yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
english: O Agni, with that light of yours, burn down him who hates us, whom we hate.

sanskrit: prācī dig gāyatraṃ devatā | yad deveṣu pitṛṣu manuṣyeṣv enaś cakārāyaṃ tvaṃ tasyāvayajanam asi | muñcemam asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ svāhā ||
english: The eastern quarter, the Gāyatra is its deity. Whatever sin this person has committed among gods, among the ancestors, among human beings — you, O [rite], are the expiation of that. Release him from this wasting disease, from this affliction. Svāhā!

The southern quarter, the Rathantara [Sāman] is its deity. [Whatever sin this person has committed among gods, among the ancestors, among human beings — you are the expiation of that. Release him from this wasting disease, from this affliction.] Svāhā!

The western quarter, the Vāmadevya [Sāman] is its deity. [Whatever sin this person has committed among gods, among the ancestors, among human beings — you are the expiation of that. Release him from this wasting disease, from this affliction.] Svāhā!

The northern quarter, the Yajñāyajñiya [Sāman] is its deity. [Whatever sin this person has committed among gods, among the ancestors, among human beings — you are the expiation of that. Release him from this wasting disease, from this affliction.] Svāhā!

sanskrit: ūrdhvā dig bṛhad devatā | yad deveṣu pitṛṣu manuṣyeṣv enaś cakārāyaṃ tvaṃ tasyāvayajanam asi | muñcemam asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ svāhā ||
english: The upward quarter, the Bṛhat [Sāman] is its deity. Whatever sin this person has committed among gods, among the ancestors, among human beings — you are the expiation of that. Release him from this wasting disease, from this affliction. Svāhā!

sanskrit: agniṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ havāmahe ya imaṃ trāyātā asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ | juṣāṇo agnir ājyasya trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We call upon Agni as protector — may he protect this person from this wasting disease, from this affliction. May Agni, gratified with the oblation of ghee, protect as protector. Svāhā!

sanskrit: mitrāvaruṇau vayaṃ trātārau havāmahe yāv imaṃ trāyaite asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ | juṣāṇau mitrāvaruṇāv ājyasya trātārau trāyetāṃ svāhā ||
english: We call upon Mitra and Varuṇa as two protectors — may those two protect this person from this wasting disease, from this affliction. May Mitra and Varuṇa, gratified with the oblation of ghee, protect as protectors. Svāhā!

sanskrit: maruto vayaṃ trātṝn havāmahe ya imaṃ trāyāntā asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ | juṣāṇā maruta ājyasya trātāras trāyantāṃ svāhā ||
english: We call upon the Maruts as protectors — may they protect this person from this wasting disease, from this affliction. May the Maruts, gratified with the oblation of ghee, protect as protectors. Svāhā!

sanskrit: pitṝn vayaṃ trātṝn havāmahe ya imaṃ trāyāntā asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ | juṣāṇāḥ pitara ājyasya trātāras trāyantāṃ svāhā ||
english: We call upon the Pitṛs as protectors — may they protect this person from this wasting disease, from this affliction. May the Pitṛs, gratified with the oblation of ghee, protect as protectors. Svāhā!

sanskrit: bṛhaspatiṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ havāmahe ya imaṃ trāyātā asmād yakṣmād asmād āmayataḥ | juṣāṇo bṛhaspatir ājyasya trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We call upon Bṛhaspati as protector — may he protect this person from this wasting disease, from this affliction. May Bṛhaspati, gratified with the oblation of ghee, protect as protector. Svāhā!
